title: We keep losing decisions because a decision's status and its lifecycle disagree (2026-11-10)

sections.name: narrative
sections.content: yes, We keep loosing decisions becuase of this. Its a real bug

sections.name: source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-10, on being told that 13 decisions sit in lifecycle draft (some with status proposed) where no session agenda can see them, and 38 ratified decisions still read status proposed. Recorded verbatim.
